summary.text: Ian T. Masters is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 91, listed with Berkeley County. His legislative page lists committee assignments on Health Care Regulation, Judiciary and Public Health.

paragraphs.text: Masters' page gives his birth date as February 27, 1986, and lists a B.S. in history from West Virginia University (2008) and a Juris Doctor from the West Virginia University College of Law (2011).
It lists his occupation as attorney, names his spouse as Katelyn, and lists four children.
His affiliations include Crossroads Church in Martinsburg and a past term as president of the West Virginia Citizens Defense League.
